name: Nawal El Saadawi
shortBio: Egyptian physician, psychiatrist, and radical feminist sociologist whose clinical and philosophical works dissected patriarchy as an interlocking system of global capitalism, religious orthodoxy, and bodily control.
centralQuestion: How do global imperialism, class hierarchy, and patriarchal religious interpretation co-produce bodily and psychological trauma in women?

keyWorks.title: The Hidden Face of Eve: Women in the Arab World
keyWorks.description: Pioneering sociological and medical-psychological critique of patriarchal bodily violence, economic dependency, and cultural silence.

keyWorks.title: Woman at Point Zero
keyWorks.description: Existential-sociological narrative drawn from psychiatric prison interviews exposing carceral and patriarchal power.
